review_candidates.title: Accountant
review_candidates.description: The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact. Since Our Founding In 2019, We’ve Grown Into a Diverse Team Of Over 260 - Working Across Europe And The US, Connected By a Shared Builder Spirit And With Our Centre Of Gravity In Berlin. Along The Way, We’ve Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register. We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us. 🎯 Your main goal will be to help build a lean, AI-native accounting function at n8n, owning core accounting operations while using automation and AI to make our processes smarter, faster, and more scalable. You’ll report to our Head of Accounting & Tax, working alongside an experienced team where you’ll have real ownership from day one and the opportunity to expand into new areas as we grow. Here's How You'll Make An Impact Own Procure-to-Pay & Expense Operations Manage the end-to-end P2P process in Ramp, from invoice intake and coding to approval follow-ups and biweekly AP payments, ensuring strong controls. Improve AI-assisted coding, automation rules, and exception handling to reduce manual work and keep transactions accurate. Support colleagues with expenses, reimbursements, and corporate card questions, resolving issues efficiently. Deliver Accurate Accounting & Month-End Close Own assigned OPEX, card spend, accruals, prepayments, fixed assets, journal entries, and balance sheet reconciliations. Partner with FP&A to ensure accurate GL and cost-center coding, timely financial information, and a reliable month-end close. Maintain clear accounting records, support audit requests, and document processes to ensure continuity and effective controls. Build an AI-Native Accounting Function Use n8n, AI tools, and modern accounting platforms to identify opportunities for automation and continuously improve workflows. Validate AI-generated outputs, prioritize human review where risks are highest, and maintain reliable evidence for stakeholders, regulators, and auditors. Help scale accounting processes across our growing multi-entity business, with opportunities to broaden your expertise into AR and revenue accounting over time. Requirements Must-haves 📚 Hands-on accounting experience: You have practical GL and AP/P2P experience, with solid fundamentals in journal entries, accruals, prepayments, fixed assets, and reconciliations. ⚖️ Accounting standards & VAT: You have working knowledge of HGB or IFRS, understand invoice requirements and VAT fundamentals, and know when to seek expert guidance. 🤖 AI & automation mindset: You're excited to experiment with AI, build better workflows, and learn how to validate automated outputs rather than simply execute transactions. 📊 Systems & spreadsheet skills: You're confident using spreadsheets and accounting systems, with strong attention to coding accuracy, data quality, and financial controls. 🎯 Ownership & reliability: You take responsibility for daily operations, follow through on commitments, and proactively identify ways to improve how things work. 💬 Clear communication: You communicate effectively in English, collaborate well across teams, and enjoy helping colleagues solve operational challenges. Nice-to-haves 🛠️ Modern finance tools: You've worked with AI-native ERPs, Ramp or similar P2P platforms, Q2C tools, or workflow automation platforms like n8n. 🌍 International accounting: You have experience working across multiple entities, ideally in a global business with an expanding international footprint. 💰 SaaS & revenue accounting: You're familiar with SaaS business models, multi-currency accounting, AR, or revenue recognition. 🔍 Audit & qualifications: You bring an audit background or relevant accounting qualifications that strengthen your accounting expertise. 🇩🇪 German language skills: You can communicate in German, although this is not required for the role. Why join us? At n8n, you won't just process transactions — you'll help rethink how accounting works at an automation company. You'll own meaningful parts of our accounting operations, build AI-powered improvements you can see in action, and help shape a scalable finance function at one of Europe's fastest-growing startups. You'll join a supportive, remote-first team where autonomy, curiosity, experimentation, and continuous learning are encouraged. Working closely with experienced colleagues, you'll have the opportunity to deepen your GL, P2P, and close expertise while gradually expanding into AR and revenue accounting as we grow. Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on? Apply now — and help us build the future of AI-native accounting. n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work. Our company language is English. You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n ( https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35 ). Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future. Benefits Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay. Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity. Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge: Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are. US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are. Health & wellness 🩺 – Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.* US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage. Future planning 💰 – Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.* US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match. Financial security 🛡️ – Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.* US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones. Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills. A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it! Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description. Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about. Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang. Country and/or State specific details provided in your employment agreement.

review_candidates.description: Job Description Summary The energy transition needs people who can see the full picture — and keep complex, multi-phase projects on track from the first milestone to the final handover. As a Project Planner at GE Vernova, you will be at the heart of project execution across the Asia-Pacific (APAC) region, turning project scope into structured schedules that engineering, procurement, and construction teams can actually work to. Maintain planning records, schedule revisions, and project control documentation in compliance with company procedures. About You You are a detail-oriented project planning professional with a strong background in schedule development and control within complex, multi-discipline project environments. review_candidates.title: Technical Solutions Coordinator
review_candidates.description: Technical Solution Coordinator Location: Sydney, Australia Reports to: Senior Technical Operations Manager / ANZ Sales Leadership Region: Australia & New Zealand Employment Type: Full-time Job Summary The Technical Sales Coordinator supports Mood Media’s sales, technical solutions and project-delivery activities across Australia and New Zealand. This is a junior-to-mid-level, customer-facing coordination role for someone with an interest in audio, visual, lighting and technology-led customer experiences. Working closely with Account Managers, Technical Operations, Project Coordination, installers, suppliers and clients, the Technical Sales Coordinator helps turn customer requirements into practical, commercially viable technical solutions. The role supports pre-sales activities including proposal preparation, site surveys, equipment selection, basic system design, costings and technical documentation, as well as post-sales coordination to support a smooth installation and handover experience. The successful candidate will be organised, commercially aware, technically curious and comfortable managing multiple priorities. They will help maintain high standards of customer service, project communication, documentation and technical accuracy across the ANZ market. This is an excellent opportunity for a developing AV, technology, project coordination or technical-sales professional to build experience in commercial audio, digital signage, video, lighting and integrated customer-experience solutions. Core Responsibilities Technical Sales Support Support the Account Management and Sales teams in responding to customer enquiries, tenders, requests for quotation and solution proposals across Australia and New Zealand. Assist in understanding client requirements and translating them into clear technical scopes, solution options and commercial proposals. Prepare quotations, proposal documents, product schedules, equipment lists, basic technical specifications and supporting sales materials. Assist with the preparation of accurate project costings, including equipment, installation, labour, freight, subcontractor and travel requirements. Coordinate with suppliers and internal teams to obtain product information, pricing, lead times and availability. Support the development of solution designs for commercial audio, video, digital signage, control and lighting projects, under the guidance of senior technical or sales colleagues. Help maintain an up-to-date understanding of Mood Media’s products, services, approved equipment and solution capabilities. Assist with client presentations, demonstrations and technical meetings where required. Identify opportunities to improve proposal quality, response times, technical accuracy and sales-support processes. Site Surveys and Project Coordination Assist with site surveys across Australia and New Zealand, including gathering site information, measurements, photographs, existing-system details and installation requirements. Review plans, drawings and customer information to support accurate project scoping and solution development. Prepare clear site-survey reports, project handover packs, installation instructions and documentation for internal teams and installation partners. Work closely with Project Coordinators, Technical Operations and installers to ensure projects are handed over accurately from sales to delivery. Support scheduling, logistics and coordination of equipment, installers, subcontractors and site access requirements. Assist in monitoring project progress, identifying risks or changes in scope, and escalating issues to the appropriate manager. Maintain accurate records of client communications, technical documentation, quotations, project updates and system information in relevant company systems. Support post-installation follow-up, including documentation, customer queries, defect coordination and project close-out activities. Client and Partner Support Build positive working relationships with clients, Account Managers, suppliers, subcontractors and installation partners. Provide timely, professional and practical responses to internal and external technical queries. Support the coordination of subcontractors and service partners for installation, commissioning and maintenance activities as required. Assist in ensuring that installation partners receive clear scopes of work, technical information, site requirements and project documentation. Help ensure that client expectations, deliverables and timelines are communicated clearly throughout the sales and project-delivery process. Escalate technical, commercial, operational or customer-service issues promptly to the relevant senior team member. Compliance, Quality and Administration Support compliance with relevant Australian and New Zealand health and safety requirements, site rules, permits, licensing requirements and client policies. Ensure technical and project documentation is complete, accurate, current and stored appropriately. Assist with maintaining product, pricing and supplier information for use in quotations and proposals. Help prepare sales reports, pipeline updates, project trackers, purchase information and other operational reporting as required. Support quality-control processes by checking quotations, equipment lists, handover documentation and installation information before release. Contribute to continuous improvement in technical-sales processes, templates, product knowledge and internal coordination. Knowledge, Skills and Experience Essential 1–3 years of experience in technical sales support, AV, digital signage, IT, electrical contracting, project coordination, customer service or a related technology-based environment. Interest in, or exposure to, commercial audio, visual, digital signage, lighting, control systems or integrated technology solutions. Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple quotations, client requests and project-related tasks at the same time. Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with clients, suppliers, technicians and internal teams. Confidence using Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Outlook. Ability to prepare professional proposals, quotations, reports and technical documentation with strong attention to detail. Commercial awareness, including an understanding of pricing, costings, margins and the importance of accurate scope definition. A practical, proactive and customer-focused approach. Ability to work collaboratively across sales, technical, operational and project-delivery teams. Willingness to travel occasionally within Australia and New Zealand for site surveys, client meetings, training or project support. Full Australian working rights and a valid driver’s licence. Desirable Experience with commercial AV, background music, digital signage, video, lighting or control systems. Experience preparing quotations, bills of materials, equipment schedules or project costings. Familiarity with CRM, ERP, project-management or quotation systems. Basic knowledge of AV signal flow, networked audio, display technologies, speakers, amplifiers, media players or control systems. CTS, CTS-D, AVIXA training or other relevant technical qualifications, either completed or in progress. Experience working with retail, hospitality, corporate, fitness, entertainment, leisure or multi-site customer environments. Previous experience coordinating installers, trades, suppliers or subcontractors. Ideal Characteristics Customer-focused and commercially minded. Curious about technology and motivated to develop technical product knowledge. Highly organised, dependable and detail-oriented. Clear and professional communicator with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Positive team player who works well across sales, operations and project teams. Practical problem-solver with a willingness to learn. Confident managing administrative detail without losing sight of the customer outcome. Flexible and willing to support occasional travel across the ANZ region.

review_candidates.title: Teamlead Operate
review_candidates.description: Teamlead Operate | Utrecht | Hybride | full-time Binnen PQR Managed Services draait het om meer dan het draaiend houden van IT-infrastructuur. Met zo’n 70 klanten, uiteenlopende omgevingen en een team van circa 25 engineers ligt er een continue opgave om kwaliteit, capaciteit en expertise goed op elkaar af te stemmen én het beheer steeds slimmer te organiseren. Daar zoeken we een Teamlead Operate voor! Een teamlead die dicht op de operatie staat, begrijpt wat er technisch speelt en vanuit overzicht en inzicht richting geeft aan het team. Iemand die ziet waar verbetering mogelijk is, prioriteiten stelt en zorgt dat goede ideeën uitgroeien tot een efficiëntere en beter geborgde manier van werken. Herken jij jezelf daarin? Dan maken we graag kennis. Dit Ga Je Doen Jij zorgt dat de operatie draait! Als Teamlead Operate binnen onze Managed Service Organisatie geef je dagelijks operationeel leiding aan het Operate-team, bestaande uit circa 25 collega’s. Het team is verantwoordelijk voor het 2 e en 3e lijns beheer van werkplekken, servers tot en met storage, van centrale en decentrale infrastructuren en van cloud- tot on-premise omgevingen en alles wat daar tussen zit en heeft uiteraard raakvlakken met onder andere het SOC. Jij houdt overzicht over de werkvoorraad en beschikbare capaciteit, bewaakt de kwaliteit, kwantiteit en voortgang van de dienstverlening in relatie tot de SLA’s en zorgt voor eenduidige werkafspraken. Je zorgt dat de juiste expertise op het juiste moment op de juiste plek wordt ingezet, zodat het team het werk optimaal, voorspelbaar en efficiënt kan uitvoeren. Jij bouwt aan operationele volwassenheid! In je rol als Teamlead Operate ben je zichtbaar en zoek je actief de verbinding. Je brengt structuur in processen en werkwijzen, creëert inzicht en zorgt voor borging. Bijvoorbeeld door controls te ontwikkelen en te implementeren, teams te begeleiden in het werken volgens afgesproken processen, kennisdeling te stimuleren en te zorgen voor duidelijke en actuele werkinstructies. Ook zorg je voor een goede balans tussen preventief en correctief beheer en stimuleer je first-time-right en first-time-fix. Je kijkt continu waar processen slimmer kunnen en zorgt dat verbeteringen daadwerkelijk onderdeel worden van de dagelijkse operatie. Zo brengen we rust in beheer. Jij benut de kracht van Managed Services! Juist als Managed Service Organisatie kunnen we onze schaal slim benutten. Vanuit Operate beheren we de IT-infrastructuur en allerlei werkplek verschijningsvormen voor zo’n 70 klanten, van organisaties met circa 250 werkplekken tot omgevingen met duizenden gebruikers. Wat we bij de ene klant leren of oplossen, kan daarom ook waardevol zijn voor andere klanten. Als Teamlead Operate zie je waar die kansen liggen en geef je richting aan hoe we ze benutten. Je herkent waar vraagstukken bij meerdere klanten of teams terugkomen en bepaalt mede waar een gezamenlijke oplossing de meeste waarde oplevert. We werken met oplosgroepen binnen Operate om kennis en ervaring te bundelen, maar daar ligt meer potentieel. Jij stelt prioriteiten en zorgt dat inzichten vanuit de operatie hun weg vinden naar andere teams en de projectenorganisatie. Dat doe je procesmatig. Zo benutten we onze schaal om klanten beter te helpen én onze dienstverlening steeds slimmer te organiseren. Vereisten Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring als Teamlead of technisch operationeel leidinggevende binnen een IT- of Managed Service omgeving. Je bent gewend SLA- en resultaatgericht te werken en stuurt op werkvoorraad, capaciteit, productiviteit, kwaliteit en voortgang. Daarnaast weet je de organisatie en processen goed in te richten en bij te sturen waar dat nodig is of waar hiaten zitten. Je kent principes en methodieken voor continu verbeteren, zoals Lean, ITIL/ITSM en PDCA, en weet deze te vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen die daadwerkelijk worden geïmplementeerd en geborgd. Je hebt brede kennis van IT-infrastructuur en begrijpt de samenhang tussen werkplek-, server- en storagebeheer, Cloud en on-premise infrastructuren. Je kunt op technisch niveau het gesprek voeren met engineers en de impact van keuzes op de bredere infrastructuur overzien. Je bent technisch voldoende onderlegd om de inhoud van het werk te kunnen beoordelen, de juiste vragen te stellen en engineers inhoudelijk uit te dagen. Je bent een zichtbare en verbindende leider: je staat dicht bij het team, spreekt je uit, maakt kwaliteit bespreekbaar en weet mensen mee te nemen in verandering. Je hebt ervaring met het ontwikkelen van medewerkers en stimuleert actief kennisdeling, training en vakinhoudelijke ontwikkeling. Je kunt schakelen tussen operatie en management en weet signalen, knelpunten en verbetermogelijkheden op de juiste plek op de agenda te krijgen. Dit bieden wij je Bij PQR werk je bij dé marktleider op het gebied van geavanceerde IT-infrastructuren. We zijn trots op onze hoge partner statussen en bieden volop kansen om jezelf te ontwikkelen en door te groeien binnen PQR en/of ons moederbedrijf Bechtle. We bieden je een passend salaris bij jouw ervaring met uitstekende primaire- en secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden. Waarom jij deze uitdaging elke dag bij ons aangaat? Simpelweg omdat wij een hecht team hebben waarin iedereen de samenwerking met collega’s opzoekt, we kennis delen en opbouwen met elkaar en op vrijdagmiddag staan jouw collega's klaar voor de gezellige vrijdagmiddagborrel! Dit alles kan natuurlijk niet zonder de lekkerste koffies, dagelijks vers fruit, jaarlijks diverse feesten en events, teamuitje en nog veel meer. Geïnteresseerd? Ben jij de rustmaker die zorgt voor een betrouwbare IT-omgeving en heldere afstemming intern en met de klant? Dan willen we je graag spreken! Reageer direct via onderstaande sollicitatie button of bel of app met onze recruiter, Brenda klever via +31 6 3133 1147 en we vertellen je alles over ons PQR-team, hoe we samenwerken aan de meest slimme IT-oplossingen voor de mooiste klanten en wat PQR voor jou kan betekenen.

review_candidates.title: Senior Planning Engineer
review_candidates.description: Company Description HSE Contractors is one of the fastest-growing scheduling, project controls, and project management firms in the United States, delivering reliable construction planning at competitive rates. The company specializes in critical path method (CPM) scheduling to help projects stay on track, within budget, and on schedule. Its multidisciplinary team of construction managers, engineers, schedulers, and claims consultants collaborates to provide end-to-end project controls and management solutions, from bid preparation to field execution. With consultants based across the country, HSE offers nationwide support in CPM scheduling, construction delay claims, cost damages assessment, BIM modeling, and site staff augmentation. The organization is driven by a mission to equip clients with intelligent tools and expert guidance, aiming to be the project management consulting company of choice in North America and beyond. Role Description -The Senior Planning Engineer role at HSE Contractors is a full-time, on-site position based in Mohandessin - dokki. -working hours from 2:30 pm to 11:30 pm /Saturday -Sunday day off The Senior Planning Engineer will develop, maintain, and update detailed project schedules using CPM methodologies, ensuring alignment with project milestones, budget, and contractual requirements. This role involves coordinating with project managers, site teams, and stakeholders to gather progress data, analyze schedule impacts, and propose mitigation plans for delays. The Senior Planning Engineer will prepare reporting dashboards, progress updates, and forecast analyses, supporting decision-making and project control activities. Daily responsibilities also include reviewing drawings and construction plans, optimizing resource allocation, contributing to claims and time-impact analyses, and ensuring that planning standards and procedures are consistently applied across projects. Qualifications - candidate should be fluent English prefer graduation GUC-AUC-BUE Professional fluency in English is a key requirement. * Fluent spoken and written English. * Strong professional communication skills in meetings, emails, and technical discussions Experience: Minimum 7–8 years of relevant experience in construction project planning and scheduling, preferably on large-scale or complex construction projects. Strong planning and production planning skills, with experience developing and managing construction project schedules. .Primavera P6: Advanced proficiency, with a minimum expected technical assessment score of 8/10. Advanced analytical skills and project control capabilities to assess progress, identify risks, and recommend corrective actions. Effective communication skills to collaborate with project teams, clients, and stakeholders and present complex information clearly. Proficiency in scheduling and project management software (e.g., Primavera P6, MS Project) and MS Office tools. Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field; advanced certifications in project planning or controls are an advantage. Proven experience in construction projects, preferably in infrastructure, industrial, or large-scale building works. Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to work independently while supporting multiple projects. Knowledge of CPM scheduling, delay analysis, and claims preparation is highly beneficial.
